en.title: Minimum Equipment Purchase Cost with Overbuying Allowed
en.description:
A and B can be bought individually, or as a bundle containing one A and one B. You need at least x of A and y of B and may buy more than needed; find the minimum cost.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line containing costA costB costAB x y, each an integer in 1..10^9.
en.explanation: The examples give 4, 10 and 3 respectively; the first and third examples rely on buying extra equipment.
hints: Enumerate bundle counts 0, min(x,y) and max(x,y), make up the missing single items for each, and take the minimum cost.
